data.street_address: Mall Level -1, Cabot Place, Canary Wharf, London, E14 4QS

description.text:
Pure’s mission is simple: to put pleasure into food made for people on the go or at work, without sacrificing goodness. Their delicious menu is freshly prepared daily in the on-site kitchen.

You’ll find freshly-baked pastries, served alongside coffee made from locally-roasted 100% Arabica beans which are ground to order for maximum freshness. You can choose from organic dairy, or free plant milk alternatives at no extra cost and bring in your reusable cup to get £1 off! Their breakfast range has everything from porridge and birchers to breakfast toasties, rolled omelettes and protein-packed super eggs. For lunch there’s just as much to choose from, including wheat bran wraps, hot Pure bowls (check out their best-selling High Protein Chilli!), salads and grain bowls that are hand-made to seasonal recipes. Cold pressed juices and smoothies are the perfect accompaniment to any breakfast or lunch. Plus, you can use their free filtered water stations to stay hydrated on to go – even if you aren’t buying anything.

All Pure’s ingredients are carefully sourced to bring you top-quality products, and they want to make it easy and delicious for people to reduce the amount of meat they eat, which is why over half their menu is vegan or veggie.

Pure also offers catering, just order before 10.45am and you can have lunch delivered to your office on the same day.
